title: Stocks in news: LG Electronics, HDFC Bank, Siemens Energy, Lupin and Schaeffler India
summary: Domestic equities rebounded strongly as the Nifty 50 surged by 470 points post-market holiday. Major players like LG Electronics India and HDFC Bank made headlines with noteworthy updates, reigniting investor enthusiasm. Waaree Renewable Technologies received...
thbAction: Use the article as an entry point to pitch THB's commercial visibility layer for territory planning, account prioritization, and next-best-action for pharma leadership teams.
contentHtml:
Domestic equities staged a strong rebound after the market holiday, shrugging off weak Asian market cues and subdued US futures ahead of the US PCE inflation data. The benchmark Nifty 50 rallied 470 points, or 1.85%, to close at 25,819. According to market analysts, the 25,600–25,500 zone will remain an important support area for the index, while 26,000 is the next psychological resistance level.

Against this backdrop, several stocks, including LG Electronics India, HDFC Bank, Waaree Renewable Technologies, Siemens Energy, Bharti Airtel, Lupin and Schaeffler India, are likely to remain in focus on Thursday, November 26, following key corporate announcements and company-specific developments.

LG Electronics India

LG Electronics Inc., the promoter of LG Electronics India, plans to sell up to 2% stake in the Indian subsidiary through open-market transactions. The proposed stake sale is aimed at complying with the minimum public shareholding requirements prescribed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi).

HDFC Bank

HDFC Bank's board has approved the reappointment of Harsh Kumar Bhanwala as an independent director for a further period of five years, from January 25, 2027, to January 24, 2032.

The decision was taken at the board meeting held on November 25, following the recommendation of the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee. The reappointment is subject to shareholders' approval.

The bank said Bhanwala is not related to any other director or key managerial personnel and is not debarred from holding the office of director by any Sebi order or other authority.

Waaree Renewable Technologies

CARE Ratings has assigned a CARE A+ rating with a Stable outlook to Waaree Renewable Technologies' long-term bank facilities worth Rs 875.03 crore.

The rating agency has also reaffirmed its CARE A+/Stable and CARE A1+ ratings on the company's long-term and short-term bank facilities worth Rs 2,243.72 crore, enhanced from Rs 2,200 crore.

Separately, the rating on certain long-term bank facilities with a sanctioned amount of nil has been withdrawn.

Siemens Energy

Siemens Energy reported an 82% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 653 crore for the fourth quarter of FY26, compared with Rs 360 crore in the corresponding period last year.

Revenue rose 30.5% to Rs 3,453 crore from Rs 2,646 crore a year ago. EBITDA increased 72% year-on-year to Rs 822 crore, against Rs 479 crore in the year-ago period.

The EBITDA margin expanded to 23.8% from 18.1% in the corresponding quarter last year.

Bharti Airtel

Bharti Airtel has received a notice from the Department of Telecommunications imposing a penalty of Rs 7.96 lakh for an alleged violation of subscriber verification norms.

The company said the maximum financial implication would be limited to the penalty imposed. It has decided not to contest the notice and will pay the penalty.

Capri Global Capital

Capri Global Capital Limited also known by the brand name ‘Capri Loans’, has raised $30 million from the BlueOrchard Microfinance Fund, managed by BlueOrchard Finance Ltd, an impact investment firm. This marks Capri Global's first-ever impact fundraise and represents a significant milestone in the company's efforts to strengthen its MSME lending business.

Lupin

Global pharmaceutical major Lupin has received approval from the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its abbreviated new drug application for Sitagliptin and Metformin Hydrochloride Tablets in strengths of 50 mg/500 mg and 50 mg/1,000 mg.

The products are bioequivalent to Merck's reference listed drug, Janumet tablets.

The combination is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Schaeffler India

Shares of Schaeffler India are likely to remain in focus after reports that its parent, Schaeffler AG, is looking to sell up to a 6% stake in the Indian company through a block deal.

The proposed transaction is reportedly valued at around Rs 3,188 crore.

Alembic Pharmaceuticals

Alembic Pharmaceuticals has received two Establishment Inspection Reports (EIRs) from the USFDA in the names of the respective clinical investigators, indicating the closure of an unannounced inspection at its bioequivalence facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

The inspection was conducted between August 31 and September 10, 2026.

The company had earlier informed the stock exchanges about the successful completion of the inspection on September 11.

Om Freight Forwarders

Om Freight Forwarders said the search proceedings initiated by the Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Department at its corporate office on November 18 were concluded on November 24 at 11:35 pm.

The company said it extended full cooperation to the authorities and provided the necessary information and assistance during the proceedings.

Advanced Enzyme Technologies

Advanced Enzyme Technologies has completed the acquisition of an additional 1.22% stake in its subsidiary JC Biotech Private Limited.

The company purchased 2,53,294 equity shares from certain selling shareholders for a consideration of Rs 2.28 crore, at Rs 90 per share.

Following the acquisition, Advanced Enzyme Technologies' shareholding in JC Biotech has increased from 96.94% to 98.16%, effective November 25, 2026.

The company said it is in the process of acquiring the remaining 1.84% stake, following which JC Biotech will become its wholly owned subsidiary.

Popular Vehicles and Services

Popular Vehicles and Services has received an order from the State Tax Officer, Taxpayer Services Circle, Palarivattom, Ernakulam, confirming a demand of Rs 81.25 lakh for FY22.

The demand comprises IGST of Rs 28.61 lakh, interest of Rs 24.03 lakh and a penalty of Rs 28.61 lakh.

The order was passed under Section 74(9) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, read with Section 20 of the Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017.

Fino Payments Bank

Fino Payments Bank's board has approved the appointment of Pratap Singh as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, subject to shareholders' approval.

The Reserve Bank of India had approved his appointment for a three-year term on November 12, 2026.

His tenure will commence from November 27, 2026, or the date he takes charge, whichever is earlier.

Global Vectra Helicorp

Global Vectra Helicorp has filed an appeal against an Order-in-Original received from the Office of the Principal Commissioner of Customs (Import), Mumbai.

The order relates to a dispute over the fulfilment of conditions prescribed for claiming IGST exemption under Notification No. 50/2017-Customs for the import of helicopters and aircraft parts under lease arrangements.

The company said the appeal has been filed in connection with the order passed under Section 28 of the Customs Act, 1962.

Satin Creditcare Network

Satin Creditcare Network's Working Committee of the Board of Directors has approved the terms and conditions for issuing non-convertible debentures (NCDs) aggregating Rs 372 crore on a private placement basis.

The proposed issuance comprises 27,900 senior, secured, rated, listed, redeemable and transferable NCDs, with a face value of Rs 1 lakh each, aggregating Rs 279 crore.

The company will also issue 9,300 subordinated, unsecured, rated, listed, redeemable and transferable NCDs, with a face value of Rs 1 lakh each, aggregating Rs 93 crore. Both issuances are denominated in Indian rupees and will be undertaken through private placement.
